name_story.story: Umair can be understood through the Arabic form عُمَيْر, whose central sense is umair; diminutive of umar. Umair is Arabic عُمَيْر (ʿUmayr), the diminutive of عُمَر (ʿUmar).

faq.a: Umair is associated with the Arabic form عُمَيْر, whose core sense is umair; diminutive of umar.

faq.q: What is the origin of Umair?
faq.a: Umair is associated with Arabic. Umair is Arabic عُمَيْر (ʿUmayr), the diminutive of عُمَر (ʿUmar).
Yes — the underlying form عُمَيْر is Arabic.
Umair can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Umair should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUmayr is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Umair mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Umair is rendered عمیر and carries the sense عمیر، عمر کی تصغیر.

faq.q: What does Umair mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Umair is rendered عمیر and carries the sense عمیر، تصغیر عمر.
A romanized syllable approximation is u-mair. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Umair?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Umair, umair. Script forms are عمير, عمیر, عُمَيْر, उमैर.

faq.q: Is Umair a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
